tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18). v2.3.1 had never been healthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent production release that was healthy. Actions taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator partial failure (us-east moved to v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west stayed on v2.3.1); I retried the rollback to v2.3.0, which completed in all regions. Post-rollback status: v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy=true, error_rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure, check the orchestrator partial-failure cause, and decide when v2.3.1 can be redeployed.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and it is healthy again with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 was the unhealthy release running before the rollback.
- **Partial failure:** The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the regions mixed. I retried the same rollback, and it completed in all regions.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer. The summary covers the failure, both rollback attempts, the post-rollback health, and follow-ups. The first attempt to open it timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key. The service returned one incident, INC-0001.

Follow-ups for the team: find out why v2.3.1 failed, look into the orchestrator partial failure, and decide when v2.3.1 can be redeployed. Redeploying it is not a rollback. v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so it will need change-manager approval.

content.text: The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0 (seq 1). v2.3.1 is the unhealthy release running in all three regions. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
The rollback reported a partial failure after us-east. I'll check the current state before doing anything else.
us-east is now on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. I'll retry the rollback to v2.3.0 to finish the remaining regions.
The rollback is complete and checkout-api is healthy again. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
